hints.title: Monotone Prefix Zeros and Suffix Ones
hints.text: A monotone increasing binary string consists of zero or more zeros followed by zero or more ones.

hints.title: Running Ones Count Tracking
hints.text: Maintain the count of ones seen so far while tracking the minimum flips needed for the prefix.

hints.title: Flip Zero vs Flip Prior Ones Choice
hints.text: When encountering a zero, either flip it to one (flips + 1) or flip all preceding ones to zeros (ones), taking the minimum.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Single pass updating ones and flips counters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all N partition points with prefix and suffix counts takes O(N) space and multiple passes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Track ones count and maintain minimum flips dynamically in a single pass.
